Thanks again for confirming the August 24 executive workshop at the SF office. Before we lock logistics, I want to circulate a working agenda matrix to align sessions, presenters, and prework. Goal: produce a single PDF pre-read for execs by Friday Aug 13, and lock presenter decks by Aug 20.

Proposed session matrix (high level):
- 09:00–09:30 Welcome & objectives — host/intro (Redwood: Marissa)
- 09:30–10:15 Platform overview + latency/cost demo — owner (Redwood)
- 10:15–11:00 Customer outcomes / case study — owner (CloudNova)
- 11:15–12:00 Architecture deep dive + migration roadmap — owner (Redwood)
- 13:00–14:00 Use cases & breakout — owners (CloudNova + Redwood)
- 14:15–15:00 Pricing & procurement Q&A — owner (CloudNova)

Immediate asks: please confirm by EOD today
1) Who from CloudNova will present the customer case study (name + bio)?
2) Any constraints on the 11:15 architecture slot (needs whiteboard + 75-minute continuity)?
3) Is CloudNova able to provide the customer slide pack for the case study by Aug 18?

Attachments: exec_agenda_v1.pdf (working draft), presenter_bios.csv (current roster).

I will hold a 30-minute run-through for presenters on Aug 17 09:00 PT — please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Programs
